step: Step 1-5: SC3 head-to-head + REM attack + identifiability pre-check
constitution_articles_applied: Article II — exact evidence (physiological simulation with published parameters)
Article VII — no weakening (honest per-stage breakdown)
Article XX — problem existence gate (over-drainage is real)

signal_ranges.overlap_rem_cough: 2.0-3.0 mmHg/s — SC3 CANNOT distinguish REM from cough in this range

identifiability_verdict.SC3_dICP_dt_alone: NON-IDENTIFIABLE for REM vs cough — the dICP/dt signal overlaps
identifiability_verdict.M5_venous_pressure_plus_sleep: IDENTIFIABLE — venous pressure + sleep state provide orthogonal information to dICP/dt
identifiability_verdict.hybrid_M5_plus_SC3: IDENTIFIABLE — M5's sleep state distinguishes REM from cough, SC3's dICP/dt provides sensitivity
identifiability_verdict.lesson_from_1_V25: The #1 V25 identifiability ceiling applies to SC3 alone but NOT to M5 or the hybrid. SC3 alone is non-identifiable for REM vs cough.

M5_alone.verdict: FAILS — misses REM apnea (T2 fail). M5 reduces over-drainage in NREM but has 0% REM detection.

SC3_alone.verdict: FAILS — high false positive rate (cough triggers). SC3 detects REM but also triggers on cough.

hybrid_M5_plus_SC3.verdict: RECOMMENDED — M5 provides sleep-state context (distinguishes REM from cough), SC3 provides dICP/dt sensitivity. Together they are IDENTIFIABLE and cover all sleep stages.
hybrid_M5_plus_SC3.rationale: The identifiability pre-check shows SC3 alone is non-identifiable for REM vs cough, but M5's sleep-state + venous pressure provides the orthogonal information needed to distinguish them. The hybrid is the MINIMUM viable architecture.
hybrid_M5_plus_SC3.complexity_cost: 2 sensors (ICP + venous pressure) + derivative logic + sleep-state detection. This is the same complexity as M5 alone — SC3 adds only software (dICP/dt threshold), no new hardware.

adjudication.overall: Neither M5 nor SC3 alone passes all thresholds. The hybrid M5+SC3 is the recommended path forward. It is IDENTIFIABLE (per #1 V25 lesson) and covers all sleep stages. The hybrid does NOT add hardware complexity over M5 alone — SC3 is a software addition.
